title: gamesfun.json
description: A game's public web3 settings, read by the in-game kit gf-web3 and written by the kit's web3 layer. Public data only: addresses, names, prices, links and looks. Never a key, a token or a keyed RPC URL. builder/web3/gf-web3/config.js enforces this schema (unknown or invalid fields are dropped; anything that looks like a secret is refused).

network.description: Devnet only. There is no mainnet in this kit.

creator.description: The creator's wallet: pool creator, collection update authority, and the loot game's owner and authority.

token.description: The game's token: launched here (a Meteora curve of its own; games.fun gets 5% of its fees), or an existing mint the creator linked (launched anywhere; games.fun gets nothing from it).

config.description: The DBC config it launched on: its own since 2026-10-12 (before, games.fun's shared antisnipe-v1 on MAIN-dev).

split.description: The fee split its config carries, as read back from chain at launch: the creator's share of trading fees and the graduated pool's locked LP for the partner (games.fun) and the creator, in whole percents.

signature.description: The launch transaction (the last one, when there were two).

signatures.description: Both launch transactions, in order, when the launch took two.

economy.description: The game's economy on loot program 0.3: currencies, collectibles, pools, boxes, recipes, schedules, lotteries, stakes, contests, holds and the authority's rules. Schema: builder/web3/economy/economy.schema.json. It replaces `shop` (builder/web3/economy/migrate.mjs).

shop.description: Items and loot boxes on games.fun's loot program. Drafts until put on sale; collection, game and treasury appear once it is live.

name.description: The Core collection's name, at most 32 bytes.

currency.description: What players pay in: SOL (wrapped for them), any classic SPL token or any Token-2022 token. Fixed once the shop is live.

program.description: The token program that owns the mint.

game.description: The loot program's Game PDA for the collection.

treasury.description: The creator's token account that receives sales.

link.description: https, no credentials, no query string.

units.description: An amount in the currency's base units.

look.description: A gf-three loadout fragment (gf-three CONTRACT §6e): what owning the item changes for its player.

additionalProperties.description: An https URL or a path inside the game.

picture.description: The game picture it is made from (a path inside the game).

uri.description: The Metaplex metadata JSON on Arweave.

listed.description: On the loot program as configured at the last publish.
